Can I also do the same with her, specially in relation to her breasts? 40246 views Q. kuttay ko marna(halak karna) jaiz h ya nahi? hamaray gar k agay ak kutta betha rahta hay aur ghar walo k ilawa koi naya aye to us par buhat bhonkta hay. yehi khatra laga rahta hay k kat na lay. aur phir agar koi mahman aye to acha bhi nahi lagta. 6536 views Q. eating of non halal meat unknowingly 3529 views Q. My question is that i have done my BCOM and persuing in MBA (Finance). Now I am confuesd that according to my educational background it becomes compeltion for me to work in any financial company ie; BANK, INSURANCE, FINANCE, INVESTMENT, and apart of this if I work in any other kind of company so that might be involved any kind of loan, interest or finance. So working in such kind of the companies is allowed according to ISLAM as per my situation or not? Because after getting completed my MBA I will only be able to apply for such industries. So please guide me in light of HOLY QURAN and according to ISLAM. 4270 views Q. Can we eat broiler chicken or egg? Is it halal or haram? Please give reply as soon as possible. 5329 views Q. Allah has made me a software engineer by profession.Currently working in a reputed software company in India. I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. So the first question is what is better?Should I continue to work in the company and made small investments towards the own work (Which I feel a long process). Or go with the instant investment by putting the portion of salary towards new job which Allah gives currently to my parents via me.Ofcaurse success will be there only if Allah wills. My second question is regarding the new work I wants to start. InshaAllah it will be website based work initially. The plan is to provide a internet based facility to people where people can learn by there and other people's learnings. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. Like one people my place his/her learning as "Speak truth even in tough situation" and another one may place his learning as "Alcohol is good for health".So people may read both wrong and right learnings also.In addition the learnings can be of any other type also like business learning etc. Its like an opinion of someone by his/her experience. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? Please consider the use of this website for business organizations also where it becomes obligatory chargable. 3091 views Q. Can I work in pizza hut , where i have to touch pork to make pizza. 2266 views

Question: Assalam-o-alikum; Mujhe deeni talim or kaam or usk ewaz ujrat k hawale se masla deriyaft fermana tha k jesa abu dawd ki hadis number 3409 mein riwat derj he ne nez Ap S.A.W ka irshaad e mubarak he "ALLAH k rasul (SAW) ka hukum ta k aesa azan dyny wala muqarar kro jo apni azan pr ujrat na ly." (Abu daud jild 1,sanan Nisai jild 1,masnad Ahmed jild 4, Mushkat)." or Mushkat mein safah number 258 "Baab ul ajr alal taaleem ul quran" mein jo riwayat he.......... beraye meherbani meri is muamley mein rehnumayee fermayein. k deeni kaam or taleem k ewaz ujrat durust he k nahi nez yeh k in ahadees e mubarika kee kya dirayat he or inse kya nateeja akhuz kya jasakta he.........mera taalluq fiqh hanafi se he, Hazrat Imam abu Hanifa ka is baare mein kya fermaan he...........meri is muamle mein aanat fermayein. Answer ID: 11053 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 310/270=D/1430) The earlier Hanfi Ulama (Imam Abu Hanifah and his disciples) are of the view that it is unlawful to take charges for prayers, but the latter Ulama have allowed it fearing that the religion may go lost: قال العلامۃ السھارنپوري في بذل المجھود علی شرح أبي داؤد: واختلف العلماء في أخذ الأجر علی الأذان فمنعہ أبو حنیفۃ وأصحابہ وأما المتأخرون منھم فأفتوا بجوازہ، قال في الھدایۃ: وبعض مشائخنا رحمھم اللہ استحسنوا الاستیجار علی تعلیم القرآن الیوم لظھور التواني في الأمور الدینیۃ، ففي الامتناع تضییع حفظ القرآن، وعلیہ الفتوی (بذل المجھود 1:303، کتاب الصلاۃ، باب أخذ الأجر علی التاذین ) This is the reason that the latter Ulama allowed taking wages for Azan, Imamah, teaching Quran and teaching of other Islamic sciences. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
